theme.name: Whimsical Blush & Floral Editorial
theme.concept: A romantic, airy wedding experience framed by lush light pink peonies, garden roses, floating petals, and soft-focus glassmorphism with high contrast readability.

rules.tinted_grey: Never use pure #000000 or neutral #808080. Always tint dark text with deep rose-charcoal (#3B1E28) or deep burgundy (#4A1229) for emotional depth.
rules.contrast_check: Ensure text overlay has scrim or semi-opaque backing (bg-white/80 or dark overlay) meeting APCA and minimum 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast.
rules.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md bg-white/75 border border-white/80 shadow-pink-100/50 for all cards and floating panels.

hierarchy.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight text-white drop-shadow-md
hierarchy.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif text-[#3B1E28] tracking-tight
hierarchy.subheading: text-base sm:text-lg font-light text-[#7A5965] tracking-wide uppercase
hierarchy.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#7A5965]

hero_background.description: Lush whimsical macro bloom of soft pink peonies and carnations filling the hero section with fairy-tale romance.
hero_background.scrim_treatment: bg-gradient-to-b from-black/50 via-black/35 to-[#FFF9FB] with backdrop-blur-[2px]

page_sections_background.description: Seamless soft pink floral wallpaper pattern blended into section backgrounds with low opacity (opacity-15 to opacity-25) and warm ivory gradient backing.

accents.usage: Corner framing graphic or story card visual backdrop
Translucent rose petal macro texture for modal overlays or interactive feature cards

floating_petals.blur: soft Gaussian blur on background petals

image_urls.alt: Whimsical light pink floral hero background with lush peonies

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing (py-16 to py-24), floating bento-style glass cards over continuous soft floral wallpaper background

motion_and_interactions.hero: Gentle pulse countdown numbers with entrance opacity fade-in
motion_and_interactions.petals: Framer motion ambient floating particles drifting down with slight rotation
motion_and_interactions.cards: Hover slight lift (-translate-y-1) and soft rose shadow glow shadow-rose-200/50

accessibility.contrast_ratio: APCA standard compliant. All card text printed on white/90 background with #3B1E28 font for high legibility.
accessibility.test_ids: Ensure data-testid attributes remain intact on all buttons, forms, countdown units, and guestbook items.

instructions_to_main_agent: Replace dark tablescape image in Hero.jsx with the new whimsical light-pink peony hero URL.
Update Hero scrim to ensure text remains crisp and highly legible over the lighter floral background.
Apply the seamless pink floral pattern with light opacity (bg-pink-50/60 blend or subtle overlay) across section containers and App body background.
Update card surfaces to semi-transparent white glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-rose-200/40) for a dreamy, high-end aesthetic.
Ensure floating petals use light pink/blush gradient colors matching the new palette.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use dark colors or dark gradients as full backgrounds.
Never hide navigation or crucial text under unreadable overlays.
